look_here_first: Start with the narrow opposite leaves and upright terminal spike of pink-lavender bilabiate flowers. Compare leaf width and habitat carefully against P. correllii and the broad P. virginiana complex.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: terminal spike of pink to lavender bilabiate flowers

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: flowers arranged in repeated clusters along the spike

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: narrow foliage is an important first-pass cue

lookalikes.differences: P. correllii is a tall rhizomatous wetland/stream-edge specialist; the P. virginiana complex is broader and taxonomically messy in Texas. For P. angustifolia, begin with the notably narrow leaves and then confirm floral/spike characters.
